_note: OCG v0.8 gate-4 branch-coverage scenarios. Each GATED chain lists >=2 scenarios that TOGETHER drive every gate branch (each rule + the default). Verified by scripts/validate-chains.mjs (runs each scenario through run_chain and asserts coverageGaps==[]). Version-pinned; NO live data. Every scenario carries a pinned regulatory citation for the routing input.

workforce-pell-eligibility-path.citation: OBBBA P.L. 119-21 SAI cutoff $14,790; ED Dear Colleague Letter Jan 2026 Pell max $7,395; short-term program 150-599 clock hours / 8-14 weeks per Federal Register 2026-04520 (Workforce Pell Final Rule). Est. SAI 1,168 < cutoff, undergraduate, in-range program -> eligible.
OBBBA P.L. 119-21 Workforce Pell excludes graduate/professional degree holders. A prior graduate degree -> ineligible, chain stops before credential ROI.

grad-loan-gap-funding-path.citation: OBBBA 2025 P.L. 119-21 professional loan cap $50,000/yr ($200k lifetime), effective 2026-07-01. Law program COA $75,000/yr for 3 years with $5,000 fellowship + $30,000 savings leaves a $30,000 funding gap -> continue to grad-school ROI.

OBBBA 2025 P.L. 119-21 graduate loan cap $20,500/yr ($100k lifetime), effective 2026-07-01. Graduate program COA $15,000/yr sits below the annual cap, so federal loans cover it in full -> funding_gap <= 0, chain stops.

showcase-hash-seeded-art.citation: OpenChainGraph Standard v0.8 21.4 decision gate; ApexLogics Showcase Exemplar Manifest c1-1. Deterministic seed routing, no regulatory input. complexity 7 >= 4 -> route to the SVG render.
